notes: Named sim presets the BiS ranker runs a level-60 band under besides the bare character. Every id is in sim/request's vocabulary (buffs and debuffs from the engine's four buff messages, consumables from its Consumes message); a test refuses an unknown one. The class kit (sim/leveling KitBuffs and KitConsumes) is layered on top and wins any consumable slot it holds.

raid.label: Raid-ready, Phase 1
raid.notes: The same Phase 1 raid context for every spec: one group of each class brings its buffs and debuffs, each spec adds the consumables its role uses, no world buffs (Forever has none), the default 180 second encounter. Where a buff has a talented form, the plain version is used unless the live talent tree carries the talent and a raid would take it; none of the improved forms qualified. Blessing of Kings is left out: the live paladin trees do not grant it, and the engine applies it to Alliance characters only, so the two factions would differ. Windfury Totem is the engine's main-hand imbue Windfury. The engine applies Blessing of Might, Blessing of Wisdom and Sanctity Aura to Alliance characters only, and Strength of Earth, Grace of Air and Mana Spring Totem to Horde characters only, so each faction's raid entry carries the half its side can use until the fork drops that gate. Nothing from Ahn'Qiraj or Naxxramas is used. The tanks (warrior-protection, paladin-protection, druid-feral-bear) share the tank consumable group, which adds armor, health, stamina and strength consumables in place of a damage dealer's; each carries its class's one potion (a rage potion, a mana potion, the bear's Stoneshield). They are ranked against the curated boss and healers of data/curated/tank-encounter.json, and carry no Blessing of Salvation, which a tank does not want.

buffs.label: Arcane Intellect
buffs.reason: Any Phase 1 raid has a mage; intellect for every mana user.

buffs.label: Mark of the Wild
buffs.reason: Any raid has a druid; all stats and armor. Plain version: Forever's Restoration tree has no Improved Mark of the Wild.

buffs.label: Power Word: Fortitude
buffs.reason: Any raid has a priest; stamina. Plain version: Forever's Discipline tree has no Improved Power Word: Fortitude.

buffs.label: Divine Spirit
buffs.reason: Spirit, a Discipline talent a Phase 1 raid priest takes.

buffs.label: Blessing of Might
buffs.reason: Attack power from a raid paladin. Plain version: Forever's Holy tree has no Improved Blessing of Might.

buffs.label: Blessing of Wisdom
buffs.reason: Mana per five seconds from a raid paladin. Plain version: no improved form in the live trees.

buffs.label: Battle Shout
buffs.reason: Attack power from a raid warrior. Plain version: Forever's warrior trees have no Improved Battle Shout.

buffs.label: Trueshot Aura
buffs.reason: Attack power from a raid hunter, a Marksmanship talent that exists in the live tree.

buffs.label: Leader of the Pack
buffs.reason: Melee and ranged crit from a raid feral druid, a talent that exists in the live tree.

buffs.label: Moonkin Aura
buffs.reason: Crit from a raid balance druid; the live Balance tree has Moonkin Form and the engine models the aura as a raid buff.

buffs.label: Sanctity Aura
buffs.reason: Holy damage taken and dealt, from a raid retribution paladin; the engine models it as a raid buff.

buffs.label: Strength of Earth Totem
buffs.reason: Strength from a raid shaman. Plain version: the live shaman trees have no Enhancing Totems.

buffs.label: Grace of Air Totem
buffs.reason: Agility from a raid shaman. Plain version, same reason.

buffs.label: Mana Spring Totem
buffs.reason: Mana per five seconds from a raid shaman. Plain version: Restorative Totems is a different talent and is not assumed.

debuffs.label: Curse of the Elements
debuffs.reason: Forever's all-magic curse, which the engine carries now; a raid warlock keeps it up.

debuffs.label: Sunder Armor
debuffs.reason: Five stacks, the engine applies them with its own periodic application; every raid warrior or druid brings it.

debuffs.label: Judgement of Wisdom
debuffs.reason: Mana returns from a raid paladin.

debuffs.label: Judgement of Light
debuffs.reason: Health returns from a raid paladin; no damage effect, listed because a raid carries it.

debuffs.label: Hunter's Mark
debuffs.reason: Ranged attack power from a raid hunter. Plain version: the live Marksmanship tree has no Improved Hunter's Mark.

debuffs.label: Improved Scorch
debuffs.reason: Fire vulnerability from a raid fire mage; the engine exposes it as a raid debuff and the live Fire tree carries the talent.

debuffs.label: Winter's Chill
debuffs.reason: Frost vulnerability from a raid frost mage; the engine exposes it as a raid debuff and the live Frost tree carries the talent.

debuffs.label: Curse of Recklessness
debuffs.reason: Armor reduction from a raid warlock.
